paragraphs.text: Palla was a human leader of a Rakdos thrill-killer gang that operated in Agrus Kos ' section in 9943 Z.C. on the plane of Ravnica .
Palla had wild knots of tangled hair, white-painted skin and crooked metal teeth, with poison claws attached to her fingers.
Kos and Myczil Zunich were pursuing her for several murders and raids, while a devkarin bounty hunter called Jarad was also after her head.
She was an indirect cause of Zunich's accidentally killing Luda and subsequent death. She was (to her own surprise) killed by Agrus Kos, who impaled her throat with a thrown sword.
